summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement under Regulation S. It sold 3,500,000 Class A ordinary shares and warrants exercisable for 3,500,000 shares at $1.00 per share, raising $3.5 million gross. The warrants are exercisable for cash or cashless, including an Alternate Cashless Exercise feature. Net proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activism, or restructuring.
